name: Garment Recolor
summary: Recolors garments to a target Pantone color or reference image color while preserving texture and lighting

inputs.description: Photo of the garment to recolor
Target color specified as Pantone code (e.g., 'Pantone 18-1546') or color name (e.g., 'navy blue', 'emerald green')
Reference image containing the target color to match

outputs.description: Photo of the garment recolored to the target color

executionNotes: This node uses Gemini to identify the garment region and color zones, then Nano Banana applies the new color while intelligently preserving texture, shadows, highlights, and lighting. Provide either targetColor (text) or colorReference (image), or both for best results. Works best with uniform fabric garments.

exampleConnections.scenario: Connect an image input node containing a garment photo
Connect a text input with Pantone code or color name
Connect a reference image with the desired color
